musica.titolo_mancante_dettaglio: The track is saved without a title. You can add it from the track row.

musica.errore_elimina_punto: The section could not be deleted.
musica.scorciatoie: Keyboard: space starts and stops, left and right arrows move by 5 seconds.
musica.passaggio_aperto: Section {{numero}} open from {{inizio}}: when the music reaches the end, press “End here”.
musica.suggerimento_passaggi: Press “Mark section” where you want to come back. Press it again at the end and the section can loop.
musica.metti_fine_da_qui: Set the end where I am
musica.senza_fine: No end: the section is just a marker and cannot loop.
musica.ripetizione_accesa: On: the music loops between start and end.
musica.ripetizione_serve_fine: An end is needed to loop the section.

musica.fuori_durata: The time must be inside the track (at most {{durata}}).
